verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents an image-inputs capability that passes images to vision-capable models, using the standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape with base64 data URIs. So vision input beyond text chat is a first-party feature, but no audio or image-generation models are evidenced. Missing for 10: audio (speech-to-text/TTS) model support, image-generation models, details on which vision models are available, independent or hands-on corroboration of vision calls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: The standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape is supported. Supply the image as a base64 data URI
